results.title: Are BCN Climate Shelters accessible to vulnerable residents?
results.content: # Are Barcelona’s climate shelters accessible to vulnerable residents? **Are Barcelona’s climate shelters accessible to vulnerable residents? A new study led by @Serena Mombelli, a PhD researcher at the @GEMOTT research group on mobility, transport and territory at the Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona, has been published in the journal Cities. The study examines whether Barcelona’s Climate Shelter Network provides equitable access for its most vulnerable residents. Since 2019, Barcelona has developed a network of over 350 climate shelters intended to protect residents from extreme heat. The authors used GIS-based isochrone analysis and socioeconomic data to evaluate the spatial and temporal accessibility of shelters within a 10-minute walking distance, accounting for slower walking speeds of 3.28 km/h. The findings provide evidence-based guidance for Barcelona’s 2030 goal of ensuring that everyone has access to a shelter within five minutes and offer a framework for evaluating climate adaptation equity in other urban contexts. ### GEMOTT.
